data.rationale: The proposal has the same four-stage procedure in the right order with the right parameters (book_title, author) and the exact note template. It differs in two ways: it opens the "top (most popular) result" instead of the book by {author}, which could pick the wrong book, and it omits the "do not download" constraint. Because the author is a parameter that is also read from the book page, an automation would still be mostly buildable.
